_comment: Known-chronic alert fingerprints the agent must NOT investigate per fire.
DESIGN.md section 1.5 item 1: aiw-stg198 KubePodCrashLooping has fired every
~5 minutes at FIRING:45+ continuously since at least July, never acked, never
actioned. Any automation that treats each fire as an incident drowns.
Each entry is a case-insensitive regex matched against ParsedAlert.fingerprint
('<alert name>|<env>|<entity>', lowercased). Suppressed alerts are still
logged and still counted as correlation context - they just never open a
thread. Review this list weekly; a suppression is a deferred fix, not a fix.
